_comment: Internal InstrumentId -> yfinance vendor symbol (ADR-0006: identity is ours; the
vendor symbol is a cross-reference attribute).
This mapping lives INSIDE the adapter package on purpose. Doc 04 describes a shared
symbology table, but a shared table earns its keep only once a second provider
exists to share it (doc 06 defers the router to Phase 5), and the layer map forbids
L1 from importing the domain. Until then each adapter owns its own column, and a
hermetic test asserts this file never names an instrument the canonical seed does
not know — the drift that would otherwise be invisible.
A wrong symbol here is the failure M6b-1 exists to prevent: the vendor answers an
unknown symbol with an EMPTY payload rather than an error (doc 05 finding 5), so a
typo ingests silently. tools/verify_universe.py is what catches it.
